newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank 90-day T-bill yield up at 7.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank 90-day T-bill yield up at 7.5 pct.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the country's central bank, sold 90-day treasury bills worth 1.243 billion taka with a corresponding yield at 7.5 percent against 6.9 percent percent previously at an auction on Monday, a bank statement said.
The weighted average price against the bills was 98.16 taka per 100 taka against the previous 98.31 taka.

The bank also sold 30-day treasury bills worth 200 million taka with a yield at 6.94 percent against 6.79 percent previously. The weighted average price was 99.43 taka per 100 taka against previous 99.44 taka. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
